## Project Overview
React Native (Expo) tree-audit app. Field users capture trees, upload full audit photos, work assigned tasks, and review map/history. Map UI: tree detail overlay must not cover map controls, and task progress is based on approved tree counts. Capture page must show a scientific name that is auto-detected and saved to the database. Guava’s stored scientific name was named `Psidium guajava`. After the Capture a Tree restyle, the capture field still stays empty when the name is stored rather than present in the species list. Planting-card gap request: reduce space between the scientific name and the assigned date (unedited). Audit card was then written to show the scientific name under the tree name. Newest card-face note reversed that: any card must not show the scientific name on the front. Search to remove it was interrupted; no removal written. History page cards should also show as the audit card. That history change was written twice and reported done. Tree profile (`TreeDetailScreen`) only showed a scientific name already saved on the record or in notes meta; three edits were issued to fill it from the tree name via `getSpeciesDefault` so Guava shows `Psidium guajava`. Those edit results were not returned. Latest user request (typos kept as given): “cheak my full app all code and find bug and solve all bug work all with db/api.” Scope is a full-app bug sweep so database and API flows work, not another narrow scientific-name pass. Workspace: `d:/5eliment/app/treeapp`. Type-check is confirmed clean: `npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false --skipLibCheck` exited 0 with empty output. Stated defect: audit save writes task status without dropping a missing column, so a rejected audit can stay open. `updateBaselineTree` in treeService was patched to a local 4-attempt drop; `auditService.ts` one-shot writes were not edited.

## Completed Work
- Removed crop/confirm so audit photos upload in full. Profile projects dropdown and app info cleanup. Clear seen notifications and hide hourly email. Hide Land Boundary Locked card after fencing. Capture a Tree opens the assigned tab and shows task progress. Replaced total task progress with an approved tree count that opens the approved tab.
- TreeMapScreen: opening a tree’s details hides Mute, current location, and Auto-Zoom Land Fence so they no longer sit on the details card. Those controls return when the details card is closed. The live GPS pill stays at the top-left. File write confirmed.
- Capture/planting: TreeFormScreen is the capture form. Form state has `species` and `scientific_name` (both start empty) and `event_type: 'Planting'`. Mount effect creates a tree identity, finds the active task or the first assigned task with no `tree_id`, splits the assigned name, and sets `tree_id` and `species`. Submit uploads every photo with `uploadTreePhoto` (first URL is primary) and calls `insertTreeRecord`. Species fallback: form species, else task name/title, else `'Planted tree'`. TREE ID and TREE NAME ("assigned task") are read-only; LAND TYPE is a selectable chip list.
- TreeCard title is species only (`splitLabeledTreeName` on `tree.species`, skipping `'Tree Capture'`, else task name/title). Assigned/in-progress cards resolve ID from `task_code` or the first 8 chars of the task id. Photo prefers latest audit front photo, then task photo, then tree photo. Condition is shown only after a monitoring round ≥ 1. Completed-with-review_notes shows EDITED in `#ea580c`. Approved badge background `#ddd6fe`.
- `insertTreeRecord` (`src/services/treeService.ts` lines 66–115): `NEW_COLUMNS` includes `scientific_name`. On a PostgREST missing-column schema-cache error it warns to run `supabase/migrations/001_add_tree_columns.sql` and writes defined non-null `NEW_COLUMNS` values into notes as `##META##` JSON.
- EditTreeScreen lines 70–72: local state `species` (`''`), `scientificName` (`''`), `eventType` default `'Planting'`.
- TreeForm styles: `readOnlyText` fontSize 14, color `#333`, fontWeight `'500'`, flex 1; `speciesValueText` same plus marginLeft 8. `scientificText: { fontStyle: 'italic', color: '#3f6212' }` is used. SCIENTIFIC NAME field at the last confirmed read: `form.scientific_name || getSpeciesDefault(form.species)?.scientific || '—'`.
- `splitLabeledTreeName` in `src/utils/treeId.ts` lines 104–116. There is no `splitAssignedTreeName`. `"Saag (TREE-A38IN14)"` → `{ name: "Saag", code: "TREE-A38IN14" }`. Trailing parenthetical is a code only if the token contains `-`, or matches `/^[A-F0-9]{8}$/`, or `/^[A-Z]{2,8}-?\d+$/` (token uppercased). `isAutoTreeId` is `/^TREE-\d+$/i`. `uiTreeId` returns a stored non-auto id, else `shortRecordCode(tree?.id)`, else placeholder.
- Fuzzy `getSpeciesDefault` and TreeForm display/submit fallbacks were issued. Confirmed writes (new baselines, diffs not returned): `src/types/index.ts` once; `src/services/taskService.ts` twice; `src/screens/Capture/TreeFormScreen.tsx` twice. One later edit failed because old_string and new_string were identical.
- Capture a Tree restyle applied: `src/screens/Home/HomeScreen.tsx` modified. White dashboard card matching the stat cards; green top edge, pale leaf tile, dark title text, assigned count on the right; title, subtitle, leaf icon, and assigned count stay; tapping still opens the Assigned tab. Before the write, JSX 562–593 was the dark `LinearGradient` `['#0e3a20', '#186332', '#22803c']` card. Stat styles 925–994: white `#fff`, radius 14, elevation 2. User did not dispute the restyle.
- TreeCard spacing search returned 18 hits. Assigned date is lines 485–489. Assigned cards use `styles.plantingCard` and a `plantingAccent` bar. `plantingRow` starts at 683 with `alignItems: 'center'`. `cardContent` at 705 is `flex: 1`. `dateText` at 895 is `fontSize: 9.5`. Three follow-up reads were interrupted. No spacing edit applied.
- Audit-card write applied: `src/components/TreeCard.tsx` modified; new baseline, diff not returned. Completion claimed the audit card shows the scientific name under the tree name (Guava → `Psidium guajava`). User then rejected the front-of-card scientific name (“given image any card not show on front Scientific name”). Search for `scientificName|getSpeciesDefault|scientificText` was interrupted. No removal write.
- HistoryScreen: two writes succeeded (`operation: modified`); new baseline; diffs not returned. Completion claimed audited trees use the same audit card as the task page (status, round, photo); planted-only trees stay planting cards. Search regex `TreeCard|renderItem|card|audit` never returned.
- TreeDetailScreen reads (pre-edit, not writes). Imports React hooks, RN View/Text/ScrollView/Image/ActivityIndicator/TouchableOpacity/Linking/Modal/Alert/Dimensions, navigation, Ionicons, LinearGradient, safe-area insets. Types import was `HistoryStackParamList, TreeRecord, getMonitoringRoundInfo, Task` — no `getSpeciesDefault` in that slice. Services: `fetchTreeById`, `ensureProjectTreeId`, `fetchTreeMonitoringRecords`; `getAuditStatus`, `getDueLabel`, `formatDateFriendly`, `getLatestAudit`; `displayTreeId`, `parseTreeMeta`, `stripTreeMeta`, `resolveTreeId`; `MapPreview`. `PHOTO_PAGE_W = SCREEN_WIDTH - 28`. `PHOTO_ANGLES`: Front View/Front/leaf, Side View/Side/git-network-outline, Close-up/Close-up/scan-outline. Lines 310–339: missing tree shows “Tree record not found.” `scientificName = tree.scientific_name || meta.scientific_name || ''`. Same tree-or-meta pattern for dbh, height, wood density, crown, condition, multi_stem, age, land_type, event_type, surveyor. Lines 585–614: identity row; scientific line only if `scientificName` is truthy (`styles.speciesScientific`). Stamp shows `Audit ${latestAudit?.monitoring_round || 1}` when `hasAudits`, else `eventType || 'Planting'`, plus `displayId`. Three edits issued, results not returned: import `getSpeciesDefault`; `speciesTitle` strips `\s*\([A-Za-z0-9-]{1,40}\)\s*$`; scientific fallback adds `getSpeciesDefault(speciesTitle)?.scientific`; title JSX `{speciesTitle || tree.species}`. Last confirmed content is the pre-edit slices.
- Full-app sweep inventory (no file modified from the list): 64 `supabase.from(...)` hits.
  - `projectGeofenceService.ts`: `project_geofences` select `*` (113), upsert `onConflict: 'project_id'` (219), update (254, 293); `geofence_change_requests` insert (318), select ordered by `created_at` desc (338–340), update (365).
  - `auditService.ts`: `tasks` insert retry up to 4 (280–282, returns `{ data, droppedColumns }`); select existing `id, status, audit_round, tree_id, tree_record_id` (315); select `id, status` (510); update (517); select `columns` (542); update completed (568) and completed plus `review_notes: 'edited'` (574).
  - `taskService.ts`: `profiles` select with fallback (48, 56); `tree_records` `.or` up to 6 (137), `.in('id')` (182), `.in('tree_id')` (186); `tasks` select `*` (238, 406), insert (309), status update (327), `in_progress` plus `started_at` (341), update retry up to 6 (387); `profiles` `auth_id, display_name` (295).
  - `HomeScreen.tsx` 123: `tasks` select walks `columnLists`, optional `project_id` eq.
  - `TreeDetailScreen.tsx` 200: `tasks` select `*` `.or(filter).limit(20)`.
  - `treeService.ts`: `projects` `id, name` (42), `name` (196), `id, name, description, status` (615); `tree_records` insert with retry (80, 87) and base retry (115); select `*, projects(name)` with `*` retry (136, 144, 533, 540, 567, 572, 848, 854, 877); sibling `tree_id` by `project_id` (205) then update `tree_id` (210); map select (289); update payload (439) after empty-payload maybeSingle (429); `locked` select (472) and update (781); delete (838); sibling `*` by `tree_id` (586). `tree_monitoring_records` select `*` (311), select `id` (350), insert (366), update (396). `tasks` update edited / retry completed (516–521) — rewritten; see treeService baseline. `user_projects` select (634), delete (690), upsert `onConflict: 'user_id,project_id'` (704). `profiles` select `*` (717), update `{ credits }` (737).
  - `appDialog.tsx`: `tree_records` `id, species, tree_id, submitted_at` (228) and `tasks` `id, name, status, completed_at` (233).
- Confirmed reads before the treeService writes:
  - `treeService.ts` 1–65: `mapTreeRecord` copies the row, sets `project_name` from `raw.projects?.name ?? raw.project_name`. If `photo_urls` is not a non-empty array, it lifts `parseTreeMeta(raw.notes)?.photo_urls`. `attachProjectNames` batches `projects` select `id, name` `.in('id', ids)`; on error `console.warn`s `[TreeApp] Could not fetch project names:`.
  - `treeService.ts` 488–567 (pre write): `updateTreeFromMonitoring` (491–499) calls `updateTreeColumns`. `updateBaselineTree` (502–527) called `updateTree`, then if `taskId` set `status: 'completed'`, `completed_at`, and if `editedAfterReject` also `review_notes: 'edited'`, then updated `tasks`. On error, retried once with only `{ status, completed_at }` and warned `[treeService] updateBaselineTree task:`. Always returned the tree result. `fetchTreesByProject` (530–555) select `*, projects(name)`, retry `select('*')`, then `collapseDuplicateTrees`. `fetchTreeById` starts at 558: empty key returns `{ data: null, error: 'Tree not found' }`; `column = isRecordUuid(key) ? 'id' : 'tree_id'`; query cut off at 567.
  - `taskService.ts` 280–419: agent fetch ends with `hydrateTaskDetails` then profiles `auth_id, display_name` → `assigned_by_name`. `createTask` insert+select single. `updateTaskStatus` status only. `startTask` `in_progress` + `started_at`. `missingColumnName` parses column-does-not-exist / could-not-find-column. `completeTask` (368–400) writes `status` + `completed_at`, optional `review_notes: 'edited'`, same id to both `tree_id` and `tree_record_id`, optional `location`; loop up to 6 drops a missing column unless it is `status` or `completed_at`. `fetchTaskById` select `*` single.
- Search `src/services` regex `\.update\(` file `*.ts` returned 16 hits (pre treeService rewrite): auditService 518–520, 569–571 (`finishedIds`), 575–577 (`rejectedIds` + `review_notes: 'edited'`); projectGeofenceService 255, 294, 366; taskService 328, 342, 387; treeService 210, 397–399, 440–442, 516–522, 738–740, 782–784.
- Follow-up searches issued and not returned: `auditService.ts` regex `export async function submit|photo_urls|uploadTreePhoto|crop`; `src/screens` regex `ImageManipulator|crop|confirmPhoto|manipulateAsync`.
- `src/services/treeService.ts` two edits, both `operation: modified`. New baseline. Diffs not returned; the requested replacements are the record of the change.
  - Import edit: removed `import { completeTask } from './taskService';`, leaving `import { supabase } from './supabase';`. Reason stated: treeService and taskService already import each other, so importing `completeTask` would loop. First save then reported a new TS error at line 517: `const closed = await completeTask(taskId, undefined, undefined, {` — `Cannot find name 'completeTask'`. That error is the state after the import-only save, while the call was still present.
  - Body edit: replaced that `completeTask` call and its `if (closed.error) console.warn(...)` with a local loop (new_string as issued):
    ```
    const taskPayload: Record<string, string> = {
      status: 'completed',
      completed_at: completedAt,
    };
    if (options?.editedAfterReject) taskPayload.review_notes = 'edited';
    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 4; attempt++) {
      const { error } = await supabase.from('tasks').update(taskPayload).eq('id', taskId);
      if (!error) break;
      const column = missingColumnName(error.message);
      if (!column || !(column in taskPayload) || column === 'status' || column === 'completed_at') {
        console.warn('[treeService] updateBaselineTree task:', error.message);
        break;
      }
      delete taskPayload[column];
    }
    ```
  - Second save notice listed no problems and said treat the file as the new baseline without re-reading. The line-517 `completeTask` error belongs to the intermediate import-only save; the second edit’s old_string was that call, so the baseline no longer calls `completeTask`. `missingColumnName` is used in the new loop; it was confirmed in taskService, not previously confirmed as a local in treeService. No re-read after the second save.
- After those two results, the next assistant response was rejected with “You did not use a tool in your previous response!” No further tool result was in that batch. `auditService.ts` 569–577 was not edited.
- This turn: assistant stated the leftover payload is gone and ran `npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false --skipLibCheck` in `d:/5eliment/app/treeapp` (timeout 90). Exit code 0. Output empty. No file was modified. The following response was again rejected for not using a tool; no later tool result is in this batch. Todo reminder was not updated and still marks the combined type-check / fix / re-check item In Progress.

## Key Technical Decisions
- Map chrome is conditional on whether a tree details card is open: hide Mute, current location, and Auto-Zoom Land Fence while details are open; restore them on close. Live GPS pill remains visible at the top-left.
- Task progress UI uses approved tree count (opens approved tab), not a total-task percentage.
- Audit photos are uploaded in full (no crop/confirm step).
- Scientific name on the tree capture page is auto-detected and written to the database. TREE NAME stays the assigned-task species and remains read-only. Card-face requirement was reversed: “given image any card not show on front Scientific name.” Assistant’s reading: remove the scientific name from the front of both cards; keep tree name, status, and dates. Search issued; interrupted; no edit applied. Capture-page Scientific name field is a separate surface and was not the target of that note. The later HistoryScreen writes did not claim to remove the scientific name. The TreeDetail profile is also a separate surface: it already renders `scientificName` under the species title when non-empty. Filling that profile from `getSpeciesDefault` does not reverse the card-front ban.
- Diagnosis (stated, not verified by a returned search): Guava is the tree name and is not in `SPECIES_DEFAULTS`, so the scientific name stays blank. Stated fix: add Guava (`Psidium guajava`) and fill the capture field from that name. Searches issued and interrupted; no Guava entry confirmed. Same diagnosis applied to the detail profile. Issued fallback is `getSpeciesDefault(speciesTitle)?.scientific`. Apply result not back.
- UI request still unedited: planting assigned card should reduce the vertical gap between the scientific name and the assigned date. That gap request assumed the scientific name stays on the card. Newest “any card” note would remove the line the gap was measured against. No style change applied.
- History request applied reading, reported after two HistoryScreen writes: audited trees use the same audit card as the task page; planted-only trees stay planting cards. Diffs not returned.
- Auto-detect source is `getSpeciesDefault(commonName)?.scientific` against `SPECIES_DEFAULTS`. Issued fuzzy rewrite (types file later confirmed modified; helper body still not in a returned slice): normalize by trim, lowercase, replace `()` with spaces, strip the word `tree`, collapse whitespace. Then exact `common` match; then exact match on slash-split aliases; then the longest alias of length ≥ 4 that contains the key or is contained by the key.
- TreeForm display fallback last confirmed in file: `form.scientific_name || getSpeciesDefault(form.species)?.scientific || '—'`. A later edit was issued to show only `form.scientific_name || '—'`. Apply result not back.
- Issued TreeForm submit `scientific_name`: `form.scientific_name.trim() || getSpeciesDefault(form.species)?.scientific || getSpeciesDefault(matchingTask?.name)?.scientific || getSpeciesDefault(matchingTask?.title)?.scientific || undefined`. Species payload stays `form.species.trim() || matchingTask?.name || matchingTask?.title || 'Planted tree'`.
- Card fallback confirmed in the pre-write edit’s old_string: if `tree.scientific_name` is empty after trim, TreeCard looks up `getSpeciesDefault(title)?.scientific`. The confirmed TreeCard write is the new baseline; its body was not returned. Front-of-card scientific name was later rejected; removal was not written.
- Form scientific text: italic `#3f6212`. Card scientific text (issued): 11px italic `#4d7c0f`. Confirmed date chrome: `dateText` fontSize 9.5, calendar icon 12 / `#6b7280`. Detail profile uses `styles.speciesScientific` when `scientificName` is truthy.
- `scientific_name` is already a known insert column. Missing-column path stores it in notes under `##META##`. Detail screen reads the same field first, then `parseTreeMeta(tree.notes).scientific_name`. `mapTreeRecord` recovers `photo_urls` the same way.
- The assigned name splitter is `splitLabeledTreeName`, not `splitAssignedTreeName`. The active assigned task is carried in task-store state from “Start Now” through Camera → MapPicker → TreeForm. Audit follow-up tasks are not new trees. Detail species title does its own trailing-parenthetical strip. Pre-edit regex was hex-only `[A-Fa-f0-9]{4,36}`. Issued `speciesTitle` regex is `[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,40}`.
- Capture a Tree restyle (applied): drop the dark gradient split bar so the control matches white `taskStatCard` / `treeStatCard`. Same navigation (`Task`, tab `assigned`), same copy.
- Detail identity stamp: if `hasAudits`, label is `Audit ${latestAudit?.monitoring_round || 1}`; otherwise `eventType || 'Planting'`. ID under the stamp is `displayTreeId(tree)`.
- Latest user preference: check the full app’s code, find bugs, and fix them so the app works with the database/API. Assistant’s stated method is type-check plus tracing real database calls, not guessing. Type-check is now confirmed, not merely stated: `npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false --skipLibCheck` in `d:/5eliment/app/treeapp` exited 0 with empty output. No compiler errors after the treeService baseline. No auditService patch. Prior unconfirmed TreeDetail scientific-name edits remain unconfirmed.
- Circular import: treeService and taskService already import each other. Assistant refused a new `completeTask` import into treeService for that reason and removed the existing `import { completeTask } from './taskService'`. Baseline task close stays inside treeService. Assistant later said the leftover payload is gone; the clean tsc run is consistent with that call no longer being present.
- `updateBaselineTree` task close (baseline, replacing both the older one-shot retry and the intermediate `completeTask` call): local payload `{ status: 'completed', completed_at }`, plus `review_notes: 'edited'` only when `options?.editedAfterReject`. Up to 4 attempts. On error, `missingColumnName(error.message)`; drop that column only if it is in the payload and is not `status` or `completed_at`; otherwise `console.warn('[treeService] updateBaselineTree task:', error.message)` and break. Success breaks the loop. Tree result is still what the function returns (task failure is a warn, not a returned error) — that return behavior was in the pre-edit function and was not part of the replaced snippet. Whether `missingColumnName` is defined in treeService was not re-checked by a read; the clean tsc run means the name resolves at compile time.
- Task completion writers now: `completeTask` in taskService remains the capture-submit path (6-attempt drop, never drops `status`/`completed_at`, writes both `tree_id` and `tree_record_id`). `updateBaselineTree` no longer calls it; it has its own 4-attempt drop. Audit closing is still a third writer and was not given that retry: `auditService.ts` 569–571 (`finishedIds`: `status` + `completed_at` only) and 575–577 (`rejectedIds`: those two plus `review_notes: 'edited'`) are still one-shot. A third `tasks` update at 518–520 sets `status: 'completed'` with the rest of the payload cut off in the search hit. Stated defect (rejected audit can stay open) is therefore still open on the auditService path. Clean tsc does not close that runtime path.
- `fetchTreeById` accepts either a record uuid (`id`) or a visible tree code (`tree_id`). Comment: duplicate codes prefer the row that has photos and a location. Selection query cut off at line 567.
- `fetchTreesByProject` collapses duplicates after mapping and attaching project names. Join `projects(name)` is retried as `select('*')` on error.
- Agent task list hydrates photo/location/condition from the linked tree because rejected, completed, and approved task rows no longer store those fields. Assigner display name is a second `profiles` lookup on `created_by` → `auth_id`, stored as `assigned_by_name`.
- Other confirmed updates that are not the stated audit-status bug: geofence lock/unlock and change-request status; task status-only and start (`in_progress` + `started_at`); tree id assignment, monitoring payload, tree payload, profile credits, and tree `locked`.

## Relevant Files & Code
- `src/services/treeService.ts` — visible file. Two edits; new baseline; do not re-read. Import of `completeTask` from `./taskService` removed. `updateBaselineTree` task close is the local 4-attempt drop loop above, not `completeTask` and not the older single retry. Those last two writes do not drop a missing column. Search for submit/photo/crop not returned.

Confirmed bodies 280–419 including `completeTask` (6-attempt drop at 387–389) and `missingColumnName` (359–366). treeService no longer imports this module’s `completeTask`. Confirmed tables: `profiles`, `tree_records`, `tasks`.

- `src/components/TreeCard.tsx` — last write succeeded; new baseline. Completion claimed scientific name on the audit card. User then banned scientific name on any card front. Removal not written. Spacing target still open (assigned date 485–489; `dateText` 895 fontSize 9.5).
- `src/screens/History/HistoryScreen.tsx` — two writes succeeded; audited trees reported as the task-page audit card; planted-only stay planting cards. Diffs not returned.
- `src/screens/History/TreeDetailScreen.tsx` — last confirmed content is the pre-edit slices. Three `getSpeciesDefault` edits issued, never confirmed. DB hit at line 200: `tasks` select `*` `.or(filter).limit(20)`. Not in the current open-tab list.
- `src/screens/Home/HomeScreen.tsx` — Capture a Tree restyle applied. DB hit at 123: `tasks` select over `columnLists`.
- `src/utils/treeId.ts` — `isAutoTreeId`, `splitLabeledTreeName`, `uiTreeId`. No `splitAssignedTreeName`. `fetchTreeById` uses `isRecordUuid` (not in a returned slice of this file).
- `src/store/taskStore.ts` — open tab. Holds the active assigned task. Not in the 64-hit supabase list. Not yet read.
- `src/screens/History/EditTreeScreen.tsx` — open tab. Lines 70–72 initialize `species`, `scientificName`, and `eventType` (`'Planting'`).
- `src/screens/Profile/ProfileScreen.tsx` — open tab. Not read in the returned slices.

- `package.json` — earlier read issued (lines 1–40); contents not returned. Type-check command that did run used `npx tsc` from `d:/5eliment/app/treeapp`.

- `TreeRecord` / `TreeRecordInsert` field lists and the `SpeciesDefault` type were not in returned slices. `updateTreeFromMonitoring` and `updateBaselineTree` take `Partial<TreeRecordInsert>`.

## Current Status
Prior feature work stands as last confirmed: TreeMapScreen details overlay no longer covers Mute, current location, or Auto-Zoom Land Fence; those buttons return when the card closes; the live GPS pill stays top-left. Capture a Tree restyle is done on HomeScreen. TreeCard was modified to show a scientific name on the audit card; user then said any card must not show the scientific name on the front; removal was not written. Planting-card spacing was never edited. HistoryScreen was modified twice and reported done: audited trees use the same audit card as the task page; planted-only trees stay planting cards; diffs not returned. TreeDetailScreen three edits were issued and never confirmed; last confirmed content is the pre-edit slices. User asked for a full-app bug sweep so database and API flows work. `src/services/treeService.ts` is the new baseline: `completeTask` import removed; `updateBaselineTree` closes the task with a local 4-attempt missing-column drop (`status` and `completed_at` never dropped; `review_notes: 'edited'` only after reject). Intermediate tsc error `Cannot find name 'completeTask'` at line 517 was the import-only save. The second save replaced that call and listed no problems.
